environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (120s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~1.2e+04 timepoints (5p step, 60n window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 240s per corner. This is only a coarse, advisory pre-grid heuristic -- it does not block the sweep, and a plausible-looking budget can still turn out to be too short in practice.
